All 18 rules were searched across the full document and the plan is submitted.

Highlights for the reviewing workers:

- **Located and substantive**: liability waiver (§11.5), mutual indemnities (§§11.1–11.4), Harpoon-side exclusivity (§5.8), AbbVie convenience termination (§12.3), Delaware law plus escalation/arbitration (§§13.6–13.7), assignment and Harpoon change-of-control (§§13.2, 13.4), IP ownership (§7.1) and trademark/regulatory ownership in our favour, licence grants (§5.1–5.3), royalty audit against us (§6.11–6.12), reps/warranties and disclaimer (Art. 10), insurance with AbbVie self-insurance right (§11.6), and an extensive reversion/wind-down regime (§§12.6–12.8, plus §9 return of Confidential Information).
- **Likely absent**: MFN, non-solicitation, liquidated damages/penalties (only ordinary late-payment interest at §6.10), and minimum purchase/take-or-pay commitments.
- **Flagged for care**: several provisions (Harpoon exclusivity, our CIC rights, trademark/regulatory ownership, self-insurance) run in our favour and should not be redlined; key limits and periods are redacted as `[***]`, so workers should read the paginated sections before concluding on parametric rules.
